channel.description: Latest articles from Andalusia Star News (andalusiastarnews.com)

item.title: EPA shifts may allow CO2 capture
item.description: EPA rollbacks and Alabama bills could strip state environmental safeguards, easing approval of a contested carbon storage project near Conecuh National Forest.

item.title: Red Level woman pleads guilty to child abuse
item.description: Former Red Level woman gets 20-year max sentence after pleading guilty to aggravated child abuse of two young siblings in Covington County.

item.title: Opp City Schools’ Dauphin enters 51st year
item.description: Opp educator Brenda Dauphin marks 50 years with the city school system as she begins her 51st year, tracing her journey from first grade teacher to ESL teacher and the students she’s seen succeed.

item.title: Remembering our Veterans: James McGhee
item.description: Remembering Andalusia native James McGhee, a Black WWII Army Air Corps mechanic, test flyer and postwar pilot whose life spanned wartime service and decades of work in his hometown.

item.title: Opp honors Martin Luther King Jr. Day with march
item.description: Opp community marks nearly 30 years of MLK Day marches with prayer, song and calls to keep Dr. King’s legacy of justice, unity and service alive.

item.title: Bulldogs fall 61-59 to New Brockton
item.description: Turnovers doom Bulldogs in 61-59 loss to New Brockton; Andalusia led early before a late turnover forced by the Gamecocks and now faces Hillcrest-Evergreen and Greenville.

item.title: Opp continues win streak with wins over Andy, Straughn
item.description: Opp hoops sets wins record at 21-5 with streak over Andalusia, Straughn and Georgiana, led by DJ Hines' program-first 40-point night; Bobcats to host area tournament Feb. 9-11.

item.title: FHS girls beat PHS, fall to Kinston
item.description: Florala girls edge Pleasant Home 55-44, then endure an 80-18 rout by Kinston before falling 44-34 in a much closer home battle with Red Level.

item.title: Florala ends January slate of games 2-1 against PHS, Kinston, RLHS
item.description: Florala boys go 2-1 to close January, edging Pleasant Home 61-59, falling 68-67 to Kinston and bouncing back with a 65-50 win over Red Level.
